 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><A NAME="fs171003_1"></A>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Notification regarding </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Filing of Amendment Registration Statement of Tender Offer </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Notification
by Subsidiary </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Tokyo, April&nbsp;5, 2011</B> &#151; Hitachi, Ltd. (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501; &#147;Hitachi&#148;) today announced that
Hitachi Transport System Ltd. (TSE: 9086; &#147;the company&#148;), a subsidiary of Hitachi, which had announced acquiring shares of VANTEC Corporation (TSE:9382) through a tender offer on March&nbsp;9, 2011, announced that the company today filed
an amendment registration statement of the tender offer notification to the Director-General of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau in Japan pursuant to Article&nbsp;27-8, Paragraphs&nbsp;1 and 2 of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act as attached.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Hitachi, Ltd. </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi, Ltd., (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501), headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a leading global electronics company with approximately 360,000 employees
worldwide. Fiscal 2009 (ended March&nbsp;31, 2010) consolidated revenues totaled 8,968 billion yen ($96.4 billion). Hitachi will focus more than ever on the Social Innovation Business, which includes information and telecommunication systems, power
systems, environmental, industrial and transportation systems, and social and urban systems, as well as the sophisticated materials and key devices that support them. For more information on Hitachi, please visit the company&#146;s website at
<U>http://www.hitachi.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"># # # </FONT></P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">- 1 -
</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Head&nbsp;of&nbsp;Human&nbsp;Resources&nbsp;&amp; Business Support Office</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:1px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(Tel: &#43;81-3-5634-0307)</FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Notification regarding </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Filing of Amendment Registration Statement of Tender Offer Notification </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi Transport System, Ltd. (the &#147;Company&#148;) hereby notifies that the Company filed an amendment registration statement of
tender offer notification dated April&nbsp;5, 2011, under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (the &#147;Act&#148;), Article&nbsp;27-8, Paragraphs&nbsp;1 and 2, to the Director-General of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau regarding the tender
offer (the &#147;Tender Offer&#148;) of (a)&nbsp;the common stock of Vantec Corporation (Code: 9382, First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange) (the &#147;Target&#148;) and (b)&nbsp;the share options (the &#147;Share Option(s)&#148;) the issuance of
which was resolved at the shareholders&#146; meeting of the former Vantec Corporation (the former Vantec Corporation was subsequently dissolved as a result of an absorption-type merger with Vantec Group Holdings Corporation; hereinafter referred to
as the &#147;Former Vantec&#148;) held on June&nbsp;25, 2004, and the rights and obligations of which were succeeded by Vantec Holdings Corporation through a share exchange with the Former Vantec on March&nbsp;25, 2005, and then succeeded by the
Target through a share transfer undertaken by Vantec Holdings Corporation on March&nbsp;1, 2006, regarding which the Company had made an announcement on March&nbsp;9, 2011. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">This amendment is not to change the conditions, etc. of the purchase, as defined in the Act, Article&nbsp;27-3, Paragraph&nbsp;2, Item&nbsp;1. </FONT></P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">- 2 -
</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&nbsp;&nbsp;(Amended portions shown with underlines) </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Part I [Guideline of the Tender Offer] </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="4%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">6</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">[Permission, etc. regarding Acquisition of Shares, etc.] </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="8%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(2)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">[Laws and regulations that are the grounds for permission, etc.] </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(Before the Amendment) </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Tender Offeror must file an advance
notification of acquisition of shares with the Fair Trade Commission of Japan before acquiring the Target&#146;s Shares, etc. through the Tender Offer subject to the Act on Prohibition of Private Monopolization and Maintenance of Fair Trade (Act
No.&nbsp;54 of 1947; as amended) (the &#147;Anti Monopoly Act&#148;), Article&nbsp;10, Paragraph&nbsp;2. The Target&#146;s Shares, etc. shall not be acquired through the Tender Offer until thirty (30)&nbsp;days have expired since the day on which
the notification is accepted (the &#147;Waiting Period&#148;). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Tender Offeror has not used the advance
consultation system of the Fair Trade Commission to acquire the Target&#146;s Shares, etc. through the Tender Offer; however, the Tender Offeror filed an advance notification with the Fair Trade Commission dated March&nbsp;3, 2011, and the
commission accepted the advance notification on the same date. <U>The Waiting Period is scheduled to terminate by the end of April&nbsp;2, 2011, which is within the Tender Offer Period. If, by the day immediately preceding the last day of the Tender
Offer Period (including where the period is extended), (i)&nbsp;the Tender Offeror has received prior notice of a cease and desist order from the Fair Trade Commission, (ii)&nbsp;the period (the &#147;Cease and Desist Measures Period&#148;) with the
likelihood of receipt of a prior notice of a cease and desist order under the Anti Monopoly Act has not ended, or (iii)&nbsp;the Tender Offeror has had an urgent temporary suspension order filed against it in a court of law on the grounds that the
Tender Offeror is a party who conducts acts with the likelihood of violating the provisions of Article&nbsp;10, Paragraph&nbsp;1, withdrawal of the Tender Offer may be conducted, in the event of occurrence of the circumstances set forth in
Article&nbsp;14, Paragraph&nbsp;1, Item&nbsp;4 of the Order indicated under &#147;(ii) Conditions of withdrawal, etc. of the Tender Offer, the details thereof and method of disclosing the withdrawal, etc.&#148; in &#147;11. Other Conditions and
Methods of the Tender Offer&#148; below. If the Cease and Desist Measures Period terminates without the Tender Offeror being given prior notice by the Fair Trade Commission under Article&nbsp;49, Paragraph&nbsp;5 of the Anti Monopoly Act or
requested to submit a report, etc. under Article&nbsp;10, Paragraph&nbsp;9 of the same act, the Tender Offeror will file an amendment registration statement of tender offer notification.</U> </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(After the Amendment) </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Tender Offeror must file an advance notification of acquisition of shares with the Fair Trade Commission of Japan before acquiring the Target&#146;s Shares, etc. through the Tender Offer subject to
the Act on Prohibition of Private Monopolization and Maintenance of Fair Trade (Act No.&nbsp;54 of 1947; as amended) (the &#147;Anti Monopoly Act&#148;), Article&nbsp;10, Paragraph&nbsp;2. The Target&#146;s Shares, etc. shall not be acquired through
the Tender Offer until thirty (30)&nbsp;days have expired since the day on which the advance notification is accepted (the &#147;Waiting Period&#148;). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Tender Offeror has not used the advance consultation system of the Fair Trade Commission to acquire the Target&#146;s Shares, etc. through the Tender Offer; however, the Tender Offeror filed an
advance notification with the Fair Trade Commission dated March&nbsp;3, 2011, and the commission accepted the notification on the same date. <U>The Waiting Period terminated by the end of April&nbsp;2, 2011, which is within the Tender Offer Period.
The Tender Offeror has neither been given prior notice under Article&nbsp;49, Paragraph&nbsp;5 of the Anti Monopoly Act nor requested to submit a report, etc. under Article&nbsp;10, Paragraph&nbsp;9 of the same act by the Fair Trade Commission, and
the period (the &#147;Cease and Desist Measures Period&#148;) with the likelihood of receipt of a prior notice of a cease and desist order under the Anti Monopoly Act has terminated.</U> </FONT></P>

<h5 align="left"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></h5>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><A NAME="fs171003_2"></A>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Hitachi Announces Effects of the Great East Japan Earthquake, </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px;padding-bottom:0px;" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>and its Responses (4<FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1"><SUP
STYLE="vertical-align:baseline; position:relative; bottom:.8ex">th</SUP></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"> Report) </FONT></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Tokyo, Japan, April&nbsp;6, 2011</B> &#150; Hitachi, Ltd. (NYSE:HIT / TSE:6501) today announced the following information regarding the effects on the Hitachi Group of the Great East Japan Earthquake
on March&nbsp;11, and regarding the responses of Hitachi, as of April&nbsp;6. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi expresses deep condolences for victims of the
earthquake and sincerely hopes for the earliest possible recovery in all regions involved. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Utilizing the Hitachi Group Headquarters for
Post-earthquake Reconstruction and Redevelopment (led by Hitachi, Ltd. President Hiroaki Nakanishi) as its control tower, Hitachi is combining all of the Group&#146;s resources in promoting the following activities aimed at achieving the fastest
possible recovery in its damaged bases of operation. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>1. Providing Support in Affected Regions </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Up to now, the Hitachi Group has already decided to provide support with a total value of 750&nbsp;million yen, including the provision of flat panel TVs,
dry cell batteries, and Disaster Victim Support Systems* for local municipalities with no charge and others to aid victims of the disaster and to assist in recovery efforts. The Group will continue to offer additional support quickly, in response to
conditions in the affected areas. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1">*</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1">Disaster Victim Support System: </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1">&nbsp;&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="1">A system that provides support to operations undertaken by municipal governments in the event of an earthquake or other natural disaster. The system&#146;s program is
provided by the Local Authorities Systems Development Center (LASDEC). </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>2. Status of Employees </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi will continue confirming the status of Hitachi Group employees and their families who have been affected by the disaster. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>3. Assistance at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station of TEPCO </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The 24-hour Emergency Response Center for Nuclear Power was established at the Hitachi, Ltd. Head Office immediately after the earthquake struck on March&nbsp;11. In addition to dispatching engineers from
Hitachi to work on joint teams formed in collaboration with The Tokyo Electric Power Company, Inc. (TEPCO) and the Japanese government, a work team comprising about 370 engineers and other workers has been formed, and up to now about 300 employees
have been dispatched to the site, where they are concentrating every possible effort into recovering electricity within the power station, assisting in the cooling of the nuclear reactor pressure vessels and pools for spent nuclear fuels, and
draining the water out from turbine buildings and tunnels. Also, over 1,000 staff members within the Hitachi Group are providing support and assistance where it is needed, collaborating with General Electric Co., a partner of nuclear power systems
business. Devoting all available resources of the Hitachi Group, Hitachi will continue to fully cooperate with TEPCO and the Japanese government in efforts to improve the situation, for example through technical support and procurement. </FONT></P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">
<h5 align="left"><a href="#toc">Table of Contents</a></h5>


 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">2 </FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>4. Assistance in resolving the power supply shortage </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Immediately after the earthquake on March&nbsp;11, the Emergency Response Center for Thermal Power was established at Hitachi, Ltd. to provide support in
resuming operations at damaged thermal power plants. Up to now, about 300 engineers have been dispatched to the power plant sites. Hitachi continues to offer proposals for new- and additional-installation of power-generating equipment, such as
turbines, in response to requests from various electric power companies. Additionally, in order to prepare and resolve the electric power supply shortages, Hitachi operationalized its privately-owned electrical power facility to be able to respond
to requests from power companies. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>5. Status of Recovery at Business and Production Bases </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Recovery operations are currently underway at the Group&#146;s main production bases. At this time, main production bases are either partially or fully
operational. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In the Power Systems business, on March&nbsp;29, production resumed with the exception of some production line at the Hitachi,
Ltd. Power Systems Company, Hitachi Works (Hitachi-shi, Ibaraki Pref.), where mainly manufactures turbines and power generators. For gas and steam turbines for domestic and overseas customers, production resumed and recovered 90 percent of its
production capacity in comparison with the capacity before the earthquake. Aiming to operate with full capacity at the end of April 2011, Hitachi is running an accuracy test for its production lines. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In the Information&nbsp;&amp; Telecommunication Systems business, support staff have been dispatched from Hitachi bases across the country to affected
regions, where they continue their efforts to recover customers&#146; systems. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In the Elevators and Escalators business, escalators and
printed circuit board for escalators and elevators production partially resumed at the Hitachi, Ltd. Urban Planning and Development Systems Company, Mito Works (Hitachinaka-shi, Ibaraki Pref.). Hitachi is accelerating its initiatives to recover its
full-scale production. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">At manufacturing bases for automotive components where production had been temporarily suspended due to the effects of
the earthquake, production operations partially resumed at Hitachi Automotive Systems, Ltd., Sawa Works (Hitachinaka-shi, Ibaraki Pref.) and Fukushima Works (Date-gun, Fukushima Pref.) on March&nbsp;25, and both domestic and overseas shipments have
begun. Hitachi also recovered most of its production lines in the week of March&nbsp;28. Hitachi will continue to resume production on an increasing number of components, and to invest all its energies into ensuring a stable supply of products.
</FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>

 <p STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">3 </FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Hitachi, Ltd. </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi, Ltd. (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501), headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a leading global electronics company with approximately 360,000 employees worldwide. Fiscal 2009 (ended March&nbsp;31, 2010)
consolidated revenues totaled 8,968 billion yen ($96.4 billion). Hitachi will focus more than ever on the Social Innovation Business, which includes information and telecommunication systems, power systems, environmental, industrial and
transportation systems, and social and urban systems, as well as the sophisticated materials and key devices that support them. For more information on Hitachi, please visit the company&#146;s website at http://www.hitachi.com. </FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><A NAME="fs171003_3"></A>FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Hitachi Announces the Decision on Year-End Dividend </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Tokyo, April&nbsp;6, 2011</B> &#151; Hitachi, Ltd. (NYSE:HIT / TSE:6501) today announced that it decided on a plan for the year-end dividend for fiscal year ended March&nbsp;31, 2011 as follows. The
record date for this dividend is March&nbsp;31, 2011. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On March&nbsp;17, Hitachi announced that it would decide on the year-end dividend for
the fiscal year ended March&nbsp;31, 2011 after conducting a detailed investigation of the impact on Hitachi&#146;s business performance resulting from the Great East Japan Earthquake. The forecast for the year-end dividend before the announcement
was 3 yen per share. Having obtained a certain level of projection on the status of excess capital, Hitachi has decided the plan to pay year-end dividend in the amount of 3 yen per share. This year-end dividend is scheduled to be finally authorized
at the meeting of the Board of Directors to be held in May 2011. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>The Year-End Dividend </B></FONT></P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About Hitachi, Ltd. </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Hitachi, Ltd., (NYSE: HIT / TSE: 6501), headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, is a leading global electronics company with approximately 360,000 employees worldwide. Fiscal 2009 (ended March&nbsp;31, 2010)
consolidated revenues totaled 8,968 billion yen ($96.4 billion). Hitachi will focus more than ever on the Social Innovation Business, which includes information and telecommunication systems, power systems, environmental, industrial and
transportation systems, and social and urban systems, as well as the sophisticated materials and key devices that support them. For more information on Hitachi, please visit the company&#146;s website at http://www.hitachi.com. </FONT></P>
